{{Quote|Head back to camp.''"<br />"''What about you?''"<br />"''I'm going to tell the governor that the insurrection is over...|Jango Fett and [[Myles]] after defeating the rebels|<ref name="Fett3" />}}
An '''insurrection''' by [[Galidraanian rebels|rebels]] against the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galidraan/Legends|Galidraan]]'s [[Governor of Galidraan|governor]]<ref name="Fett3" /> ocurred in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="Warfare" /> The insurrection was ended by the [[True Mandalorians]] led by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] in exchange for information on the True Mandalorians' rival [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] faction [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], led by [[Tor Vizsla]].<ref name="Fett3" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The insurrection first appeared in the [[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 3|third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries, written by [[W. Haden Blackman|Haden Blackman]], penciled by [[Ramón F. Bachs]], and published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="Fett3" /> on [[July 31]], [[2002]].<ref name="ReleaseDate">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54274/star_wars_jango_fett_-_open_seasons_2002_3|text=Star Wars: Jango Fett - Open Seasons (2002) #3}}</ref>
